result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly impacted by active construction, which has blocked the sidewalk on one side and obscured sightlines. Existing road markings are severely faded, and the pavement is in poor condition, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Closure
hazards.description: Construction fencing completely blocks the sidewalk on the left side of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are almost entirely worn away, making the crossing point unclear to drivers.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt creates trip hazards and may cause vehicles to swerve.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Provide a protected temporary walkway with water-filled barriers to maintain pedestrian access during construction.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers at the intersection to improve crossing safety.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide sidewalks and signalized zebra crosswalks, providing basic infrastructure. However, the multi-lane roadway creates a long crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crosswalk across the multi-lane street

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and patching in the roadway surface could pose a minor hazard.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the crossing to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide, well-maintained sidewalks. However, the environment lacks physical buffers like street trees or bollards, and the crossing distance remains unprotected by a median or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation, such as trees or bollards, between the wide sidewalks and the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add vertical elements along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly compromised by active construction that has blocked the sidewalk on the right side of the street. There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to navigate a roadway shared with heavy construction vehicles.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Blockage
hazards.description: Construction barriers completely block the sidewalk on the right side of the image, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the construction site.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at the intersection, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Path
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway around the construction site to maintain pedestrian connectivity.
